description: Lists subscribers visible to the key (in-scope subscribers only). Cursor-paginated. Requires scope read:subscribers.

queryParameters.name: limit
queryParameters.description: Page size — how many subscribers to return per page. Alias: pageSize. Must be an integer from 1 to 500. Anything else is rejected with 400 validation_failed naming whichever of the two spellings you sent and the bound it broke: a non-numeric value (abc, 1.5), a value below 1 (0, -1), or a value above 500. Nothing is silently rounded or clamped — if you ask for 1000 you get an error stating the maximum is 500, not a page of 500. Omit the parameter for the default of 50.

queryParameters.name: cursor
queryParameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a prior response's meta.nextCursor. Alias: nextToken. A cursor is only valid for the same sort it was issued for.

queryParameters.name: sort
queryParameters.description: Sort field, optionally prefixed with "-" for descending. When omitted, results are newest-first.

queryParameters.name: planId
queryParameters.description: Filter by assigned service plan. Must be a valid UUID — a malformed value is rejected with 400 validation_failed rather than silently matching nothing. A well-formed id that matches no plan returns 200 with an empty list.

children.name: serviceAddress
children.description: Omitted from the response entirely when not set (never returned as JSON null).

children.name: suspendReason
children.description: Present only while suspended; omitted (not null) otherwise.

children.name: suspendedAt
children.description: Omitted (not null) when the subscriber has never been suspended.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Omitted (not null) when no metadata is set.

children.name: activatedAt
children.description: Omitted (not null) until the subscriber's first host attach.

import http.client


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.ui.com")
payload = ''
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>'
}
conn.request("GET", "/v1/carrier/subscribers?limit=%7Blimit%7D&cursor=%7Bcursor%7D&sort=%7Bsort%7D&planId=%7BplanId%7D&suspended=%7Bsuspended%7D", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
